support_span_sample.quote: Notably, acquired resistance to osimertinib exhibits adaptive downregulation of FUNDC1, rendering resistant EGFR-mutant NSCLC cells more sensitive to nitidine.
Collectively, these findings position nitidine as a promising therapeutic strategy to enhance the efficacy of EGFR inhibitors and overcome osimertinib resistance in EGFR-mutant NSCLC.
